description: The first stage is complete! More than 400 signs delivered across Tennessee. Six days of forums, podcasts, emails, questionnaires, sign placing, and conversations. A lot of miles - and so many people who made every one worthwhile. We have two weeks of early voting ahead, a brief pause, and then Election Day on November 3. We’re pushing to the very end!
